desc: Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations') - Intimation of Schedule of Analyst/Institutional Investors/ Fund Meeting to be held on 2 September 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Schedule III and other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Regulations, please find enclosed letters date 28 August 2026 issued by ICRA Limited ("ICRA Limited") received today i.e. 28 August 2026 at 1:28 p.m. (IST), re-affirming the credit rating. Detailed disclosure in this regard is attached.
